fails if an open finding again yields promotable-stale
fails if the open-finding row again offers crew complete
fails if the open-finding kind stops naming repair
fails if both reason and action omit the advice hold
fails if the resume action targets an ID other than the fixture's subject
fails if an advice-held row offers crew complete
fails if the overdue review loses its review-missing kind
fails if the measured age falls to 120 seconds or less
fails if the action omits overdue
fails if the action omits the independently fixed 50-minute age
fails if the old 120-second promise returns
fails if the reflex-owned duty offers a dispatch command
fails if a working review is again labelled review-missing
fails if neither reason nor action names the fixture's review run ID; it does not constrain which field names it
fails if neither reason nor action names working; it does not constrain which field names it
fails if the queued row changes kind; the unchanged base already passes
fails if the queued action contains r-answered; the fixture does not prove that refusal was answered
fails if the queued action contains crew complete; the unchanged base already passes
fails if the derived row ID differs from the subject ID given to the fixture
fails if the admission-held action omits the subject ID; it can still include another ID
fails only if the action invents r-answered, which the admission-held fixture never supplies

findings.text: The no-review-tier branch returns a promotable row before _selected_review and _undisposed_blocking_findings run; a manually reviewed non-runtime change with an open blocking finding is still offered crew complete, violating the absolute goal.

The resolved-admission-refusal case records only a stale failure string and never creates an answered finding; it passes at the unchanged base, so it cannot prove the promised current-hold transition.
The admission-held fixture has no foreign run or refusal, so excluding r-answered is vacuous; requiring the own ID at :228 would still pass if a command also named another run.
